# tone.dad

> Justin Herrera — videographer, real estate advisor, site builder, and dad based in Morristown, NJ.

## About

Justin Herrera runs three businesses under the tone.dad brand:

1. **Tonemedia** — NJ's premier wedding film duo (Justin & Stephanie Herrera). 350+ weddings, 12 years. Past clients include NBC Universal, Taylor Swift ("Blank Space" music video), Katy Perry (×3), Lady Gaga (×2, as assistant editor), and the NY Jets (5 NFL seasons). Website: tonemediastudio.com

2. **Tonehomes** — Real estate advisory for couples, families, and first-time investors in New Jersey. Justin and Stephanie paid off $150k in debt and house-hacked their way to 6 units. They help people build slowly rather than close fast.

3. **Tonebuild** — Web design and development. Justin designs and builds full sites in a day — brand, copy, code, shipped. This site (tone.dad) is the demo. Built with Claude Code.

## Newsletter

"Notes from the edit suite" — subscriber-only stories about faith, fatherhood, building things at 4 AM, and the work behind the work. Published via beehiiv at tonedad.beehiiv.com/subscribe.

Stories:
